USA.note: Contiguous United States; Alaska and Hawaii omitted.

NOR.note: Mainland Norway and coastal islands; Svalbard omitted.

NZL.note: Main islands of New Zealand; remote outlying islands omitted.

PRT.note: Continental Portugal; Madeira and the Azores omitted.

ECU.note: Mainland Ecuador; the Galápagos Islands are omitted for a readable outline.

MUS.note: Main island of Mauritius; Rodrigues and other outlying islands are omitted.

SYC.note: Main Seychelles islands around Mahé and Praslin; distant outer islands are omitted.

TUV.note: Funafuti atoll, Tuvalu's capital island group; the other distant atolls are omitted for a readable outline.
